caption: A laptop lid is lowered, and it snaps shut over the last small gap and stays closed thanks to the magnets inside.

sa.check: The lid is lowered toward the base.
Over the last small gap the lid closes onto the base.
The final gap closes as a snap: the lid completes its travel after the hand stops pushing.
The order is lower, snap shut, stay closed.

pc.expect: The lid moves down while it is being lowered and, on its own, only over the last small gap; left standing at a wide angle it stays there.
pc.fail: The lid, left standing at a wide angle, swings shut with nothing touching it; or reverses and rises while the hand still presses it down; or swings open and shut several times before closing.

pc.expect: Once the lid reaches the last small gap it closes fully onto the base and stays shut for the rest of the clip.
pc.fail: The lid stops a gap short of closed and rests there; or springs back open after touching the base; or bounces open and shut on the base; or opens again by itself later in the clip.

pc.expect: The lid stays a rigid flat panel hinged at the back; its front edge comes down onto the base's front edge.
pc.fail: The lid bends or bows as it closes; or one corner rests shut while the other stands open; or the hinge side lifts off the base as the front closes; or the lid slides across the base rather than hinging down.

pc.expect: The base and the things beside it stay still as the lid snaps shut.
pc.fail: The base slides or tips on the desk as the lid comes down; or a mouse, cup or papers beside the laptop jump at the snap; or the laptop turns on the desk.

pc.expect: One laptop with one lid and one base; the lid closes onto the base without passing into it; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The lid sinks into the base; or the lid detaches from its hinge; or a second laptop or lid appears; or fingers pass through the lid.

pc.expect: The laptop's colour, its logo and stickers, and the desk stay the same.
pc.fail: The lid changes colour; or a logo or sticker moves or vanishes; or the desk surface changes.
